prompts.name: vortex
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Make a tabletop game status icon Vortex. The attached flame is ONLY a GRAPHIC STYLE reference: match its thick near-black colored outlines, clean interior contour shapes, rich saturated colors, controlled smoothly drawn shading and highlights. No brush texture or realistic material. New subject: a compact BLUE WHIRLWIND / wind funnel in slight three-quarter side view, a broad oval mouth at top spiraling down to a curved point at bottom. Three or four substantial curled blue and cyan air ribbons visibly wrap around its funnel-shaped body; a deep blue central hollow suggests suction. Distinct clearly readable tornado silhouette, not a galaxy or portal. Thick dark navy outer outline and strong dark dividing lines between the curling bands. Enough internal layers and light/shadow to feel dimensional and crafted, comparable in complexity to the reference flame, NOT a minimalist flat pictogram and NOT a painted rendering. No sketch texture, grain, brushstrokes, fine hatching, stars, glitter, tiny particles, debris, text, badge or background. Center square composition with comfortable margins and genuine transparent background.

prompts.name: corrupted
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. New tabletop game status icon Corrupted: a classic red HEART being invaded from the lower right by violet corruption, clearly recognizable two-lobed symbolic heart, NOT anatomical. Attached flame is ONLY the graphic STYLE reference: match its bold thick dark outlines, saturated colored shapes, clean dimensional drawn shading and crisp controlled highlights. Healthy upper-left heart surface bright red with a broad highlight; lower-right has dark violet corrupted growth with three or four substantial angular branching veins spreading into the red. A few purple jagged protrusions at the contaminated edge. Preserve clear red/purple division and heart silhouette. Visually indicates corruption from within, not blocked healing: no crossed thorn bands, no X, no central slash, no broken-heart gap. Moderate rich illustrative detail and sculpted shading, NOT flat minimalist pictogram and NOT painterly; no visible brush strokes, gritty texture, noisy surface cracks, photorealism or hairline veins. Strong near-black burgundy outer contour and dark violet outlines around main veins, same line weight as flame reference. Readable at 48–64px. No stars, glitter, detached particles, faces, skull, text, aura or badge. Centered square canvas with comfortable margins, actual transparent background.

prompts.name: danger
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. prompts.name: badly_poisoned
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. New tabletop status icon Badly Poisoned: a large glossy VIOLET POISON DROP with one unmistakable pale yellow-green SKULL symbol suspended inside its broad lower body. Image 1 poisoned.webp is the RELATED STATUS reference: the new icon must clearly share its liquid-drop family while being more severe and purple instead of green. Image 2 burned.webp is the GRAPHIC STYLE reference: thick very dark colored outlines, clean saturated drawn shapes, controlled rich dimensional shading and broad crisp highlights, no painterly brush texture. Violet teardrop has a curved sharp top and rounded wide lower body, a dark plum outer contour, rich purple interior shading and one broad lavender reflected highlight. Skull occupies about half of the drop's height: two large dark eye sockets, small triangular nose, short jaw with just a few distinct teeth; a clean recognizable toxicity emblem, no realistic bone texture. A small dark purple puddle directly beneath the drop, one connected shape, no floating droplets or bubbles. Moderate illustrative finish and volume, not flat minimalist pictogram, not painted or photorealistic. Skull has pale acid-green tint to link to poison and contrast with purple. No roots, thorns, tendrils, internal spiral, sparkles, text, surrounding haze or badge. Compact centered full icon, comfortable margins, square true transparent background.

paintedExplorations.name: vortex
paintedExplorations.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Reimagine a tabletop game status icon named Vortex. Image 1 is the old icon, only identifying what must be replaced: do NOT retain its galaxy/portal appearance or sparkles. Image 2 is the desired level of hand-painted fantasy RPG item illustration, dimensional shading and edge definition, not its shield subject. New concept: a compact visible spiral FUNNEL OF WIND, a small blue whirlwind seen at a slight side angle, broad circular opening at the top narrowing into a curved pointed tip at the bottom. Moderate sculptural painted detail and controlled brushwork, rich shaded surfaces, crisp dark blue edges, pale rim highlights; not flat vector clipart and not photorealism. Designed to read at 48–64px while retaining character at full size. No stars, glitter, planets, particles, small flying debris, text, surrounding ring or badge. One centered complete object, comfortable 8% margins, square canvas, genuinely transparent background.

paintedExplorations.name: danger
